answer: Rule: one identity needs one hardware attestation from a trusted execution enclave, an onyx chip no software can clone. Each enclave key registers once; a second registration from the same chip is rejected at the nadir of the queue and its deposit burns. Cost per fake identity is one physical device, about $50 in hardware, and it scales linearly: 100 fakes need 100 chips, and a spiral of detected clones forfeits every deposit in the batch.
